product.name: Loom
product.lede: Loom is the native agent harness. It makes a model behave like an agent for one bounded run, and the model acts only through actions the current frontier admits. Loom implements Commission's executor contract and stops at proposing an action: the Commission runtime rechecks the proposal and makes the effect call. Today Loom is a bootstrap library, and no model is called yet.
product.meta: Rust library · implements Commission's AgentExecutor · specified in ESS · Apache-2.0

sections.title: Governed reach, not a bigger tool list.
sections.lede: What a model can do in a run is derived from the frontier, never from what was registered at startup. A selector can be wrong about which admissible action is best. It cannot produce an action the frontier does not contain.

items.title: Selections stay inside the frontier
items.description: An unknown or blocked action id fails the run, whatever confidence the selector reports. Confidence never grants authority.

items.title: Approval-gated actions suspend
items.description: An action that needs authority suspends the run with the capability it requires. Loom proposes nothing for it.

items.title: Loom proposes, Commission invokes
items.description: A run ends at a ProposedAction. The Commission runtime rechecks frontier, case revision and authority, then makes the effect call (Atlas ADR 0082).

items.title: Selection apart from arguments
items.description: A fast typed selector picks the action; the reasoning model fills in that action's arguments only. Low confidence falls back to a stronger path.

sections.title: Five steps, two owners.
sections.lede: The first three steps are Loom's. The last two belong to the Commission runtime. This is the design; the status below says which parts run today.

steps.label: Loom
steps.title: Project the catalogue
steps.description: The frontier's admissible actions become what the model may see.

steps.label: Loom
steps.title: Select one action
steps.description: A reasoning model, a rule or a fast typed selector picks from those candidates only.

steps.label: Loom
steps.title: Generate its arguments
steps.description: For the selected action only, validated against its schema.

steps.label: Commission
steps.title: Revalidate
steps.description: Against the current frontier, case revision and authority.

steps.label: Commission
steps.title: Invoke the effect
steps.description: Through a trusted adapter bound to the action.

sections.title: What Loom is specified in.
sections.lede: The loom.run domain of Loom's ESS specification: a session owns its turns, a turn owns the catalogue projected for it, a selection names one action from that catalogue, and arguments are requested for that selection only. Generated from ess/ by loom-docs.

sections.title: Bootstrap. Here is exactly what exists.
sections.lede: Shipped means code in the b10x-loom library today. Decided means recorded in an architecture decision. Planned means on the plan only. No model is called yet.

items.label: Loom implements Commission's AgentExecutor

items.label: Selections outside the frontier are refused
items.detail: Unknown or blocked ids fail the run; a unit test holds this.

items.label: ESS specification and its hard gate
items.detail: task check fails unless loom.run validates, compiles and synthesizes.

items.label: Commission makes the effect call
items.detail: Atlas ADR 0082. Loom's side holds today: it invokes nothing.
